stanza:label: Variant / Frequency
stanza:definition: Display alternate allele frequencies of the variant
stanza:author: Daisuke Satoh

stanza:parameter.stanza:description: TogoVar ID (required if variant is not given)
Variant in VCF notation CHROM-POS-REF-ALT (required if tgv_id is not given)
TogoVar API base URL. A variant search API URL is normalized to its base URL.
Message displayed when there are zero data

stanza:parameter.stanza:description: When true, auth status is checked even on localhost. Default: false
